Core transfer logic: bot checks, cooldown/timestamp checks, automatic ETH swap and fee distribution.

Splits contract ETH balance and sends it to the two fee wallets.

Applies reflection math, debits/credits rOwned, takes team fee and reflects fees.

Pure computation of tFee, tTeam and tTransferAmount.
Pure computation of rAmount, rFee and rTransferAmount.

edges.reason: Transfer source address flows into _transfer for validation and balance updates.
Transfer destination address flows into _transfer for validation and pair checks.
Transfer amount flows into _transfer where it is compared to _maxTxAmount.
tokenAmount is used as the swap input amount.
ETH amount is split and forwarded to the fee wallets.
Array parameter is iterated to flag blacklisted addresses.
Address parameter is used to clear the blacklist flag.
Sender is debited in the reflection balance mapping.
Recipient is credited in the reflection balance mapping.
Token amount drives fee/reflection calculations.
Owner parameter indexes the allowance mapping.
Spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping.
Amount parameter is stored as the allowance value.
Team fee amount is multiplied by the rate and credited to the contract.
_msgSender returns the caller-controlled msg.sender value.
Constructor assigns the initial reflection supply to the deployer (msg.sender).
transfer uses _msgSender as the from address.
transferFrom uses _msgSender as the spender for allowance checks.
manualswap authorization depends on the caller equalling _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorization depends on the caller equalling _feeAddrWallet1.
Timestamp is read into the cooldown mapping, making transfer eligibility time dependent.
Timestamp is passed as the liquidity addition deadline in openTrading.
Timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router.
owner() is consulted in _transfer to bypass bot, cooldown and swap logic.
Owner is read in the constructor for fee-exclusion setup.
Constructor writes the owner state variable.
Constructor assigns the first payable fee wallet.
Constructor assigns the second payable fee wallet.
Constructor credits _rOwned with the entire reflection supply.
_transfer resets the tax fee percentage before computing values.
_transfer resets the team fee percentage before computing values.
_transfer reads the blacklist mapping for the from/to addresses.
_transfer reads and writes the cooldown mapping using block.timestamp.
_transfer enforces the maximum transaction amount.
The pair address determines whether the transfer is a buy or sell.
_transferStandard subtracts and adds reflection balances.
_takeTeam credits reflection team fees to the contract.
_reflectFee reduces the total reflection supply.
_reflectFee accrues the total fee tokens.
openTrading stores the router instance.
openTrading stores the created pair address.
openTrading sets the trading flag at the end of setup.
openTrading enables automatic swapping.
openTrading enables the cooldown mechanism.
openTrading resets the max transaction amount.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
_transfer delegates token accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer forwards execution to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam for the team fee.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee for the reflected fee.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute amount components.
_getValues calls _getTValues for token amounts.
_getValues calls _getRValues for reflection amounts.
_getValues calls _getRate to obtain the current rate.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply for supplies.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router swap external call.
_transfer performs an external swap before completing state accounting, enabling reentrancy.
_transfer sends accumulated ETH to fee wallets after the swap.
openTrading adds liquidity through the router external call.
openTrading creates the pair through the factory external call.
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to the payable fee wallets.
transfer calls the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom calls the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the allowance.
approve delegates to _approve.
balanceOf converts reflections via tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection obtains the current rate from _getRate.
The router swap transfers tokens back into this contract, re-entering the transfer path.
manualswap invokes swapTokensForEth.
manualsend invokes sendETHToFee.
setCooldownEnabled toggles the cooldownEnabled flag.
removeStrictTxLimit restores the maximum transaction amount.
setBots marks addresses as bots.
delBot clears the bot flag for an address.
Local contract token balance is passed into the swap function.
Local currentRate holds the computed reflection rate.
_takeTeam calls _getRate to convert the team fee into reflections.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _transfer.from is only meaningful inside _transfer, so fold it into the function node.
Parameter _transfer.to is only meaningful inside _transfer, so fold it into the function node.
Parameter _transfer.amount is only meaningful inside _transfer, so fold it into the function node.
Parameter tokenAmount belongs to swapTokensForEth and should be merged into it.
Parameter amount belongs to sendETHToFee and should be merged into it.
Array parameter bots_ is local to setBots and merges into that function.
Parameter notbot is local to delBot and merges into that function.
Parameter sender is used only within _transferStandard.
Parameter recipient is used only within _transferStandard.
Parameter tAmount is used only within _transferStandard.
Parameter owner belongs to the private _approve helper.
Parameter spender belongs to the private _approve helper.
Parameter amount belongs to the private _approve helper.
Parameter tTeam is used only inside _takeTeam.
Local contractTokenBalance is computed and consumed solely inside _transfer.
Local currentRate is computed inside _getRate and returned as the rate.
